title: ReviewedState
description: What is marked reviewed after a change to it, returned by analysis.setReviewed. Every other analysis.* method returns the whole AnalysisView so the renderer replaces its state wholesale; this one returns only the marks. It carries the whole of the thing that changed, which is what that convention is for, and a three-hundred-node document with every explanation in it would otherwise cross the bridge on each of three hundred toggles.

analysisId.description: The analysis these marks belong to. Sent back so a renderer holding a different analysis can tell that the answer is not about the one it is showing.

reviewedNodeIds.description: Ids of every node now marked reviewed, not only the ones this call touched.
